choices.reason: No rule separates the candidates: the paper designates both gain contrasts as core planned results, and neither the abstract nor the introduction gives one priority. Both have participant-level means, SDs and counts; they are different contrasts at the same upgrade stage with different controls, each within an initial-use stratum, so rules 3-6 do not select either.
choices.locator: PDF p. 6 (printed p. 45), Section 3.3.4 (quoted); see also Abstract (PDF p. 1), Introduction (PDF p. 2), Section 3.1 (PDF p. 5), and Table 4 (PDF p. 7).
choices.quote: 관심 효과는 time×그룹 2 상호 작용이며, 계획 대비(planned contrasts)로 아래 비교를 핵심 결과로 보고한다. ·도입 효과: (B1의 상승폭) − (B2의 상승폭) ·중단 효과: (A1의 상승폭) − (A2의 상승폭)
